headline: Autonomous Solar Boat Capstone Project Expo
body:
Event: Final Year Engineering Project Showcase.

Date: October 14, 2026.

Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering students presented their Autonomous Solar Boat prototype. The system operates on dual solar panels and GPS navigation. Coordinated by Prof. R. Senthil.

# Autonomous Solar Boat Capstone Project Expo

Event: Final Year Engineering Project Showcase.
Date: October 14, 2026.
Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering students presented their Autonomous Solar Boat prototype. The system operates on dual solar panels and GPS navigation. Coordinated by Prof. R. Senthil.
